capture_method: Dedicated native macOS application-window captures using the computer-use screenshot API after final UI build, native qualification and installation. JPEG bytes saved exactly as returned, without cropping, resizing, compositing or retouching.
source_images: The four public-domain JPEG photographs included in sample-photos; the RAW engine badge identifies the active engine preference, not the source format.
